title: QA passes remain accepted across lane commits
when: An item lane advances after a QA method passed on an earlier lane commit.
need: Keep the run's start commit as an observation only. The latest completed passing run on an effective item requirement remains accepted after lane advances and rebases, even without a recorded start commit; no new capture is needed. Newer failures or incomplete attempts, stale configuration and target, subject proof and human review still block; required queue CI tests the final commit.
